text: Ɓee heeferɓe e wonɓe e diinaaji goo, hino faandorii fefindagol maɓɓe fenna ko Muhammadu (jom-kisiyee) addi kon, gaynugol fii lislaamu, ɓe bonna kala hujja ɓannginɗo tawhiidi e kon ko Nulaaɗo on addi. Alla non no saloo si wanaa nde O timmiŋta diina Makko kan, O ɓamta ka e ɗiya diinaaji, hay si heeferɓe ɓen faalaaka ɗum, Alla waɗay ɗum. Si Alla faandanike huunde, faandaare goɗɗo goo bonay e hoore-mayre.
